measurement_interface.alignment_checks: All next-token targets matched source bin[position_id+1]; original low/high masks matched CSR recount; exact old-NPZ/CSR counts and p*a/l=q/top1 conservation checked.
measurement_interface.bootstrap: 200 original context-block resamples, seed20261018; selected aggregate descriptive intervals only, not independent documents.
measurement_interface.companions: 964 original low targets x 962 original common IDs, TRAIN/EVAL joint counts and P(c|i), and per-rule own-expert q; compressed full CSV and NPZ.
measurement_interface.conflict_pairs: 27 TRAIN-selected rule/case cross-owner pairs, frozen before EVAL; necessary tau<=1-n_ij/(n_i+n_j) bound, not global optimality or learning-capacity bound.
measurement_interface.feature_event: Original positive gated shared CrossCoder z, full CSR feature IDs; no new threshold or truncation.
measurement_interface.loader: CSV/JSON via standard readers, NPZ via numpy.load, source parent cache via torch.load(map_location=cpu,mmap=True); scripts/core_metrics.py, scripts/score_audit.py and scripts/cases_conflicts.py, listed above.
measurement_interface.q_ei: n_ei/N_e; feature frequency within expert input
measurement_interface.score_counterfactual: Original C score terms virtually zeroed; original z, memberships, denominators, tie/fallback and model inputs unchanged. Saved diagnostic routes are not a replacement live router.
measurement_interface.text_cases: Three TRAIN-frozen feature IDs9297/1133/2704; 12 EVAL cards (three fixed-seed random and one high-activation per feature); tokenizer-only decoding, target label separate from visible prefix.

identity.parent_interface_boundary: Only parent cache/routes and tokenizer/source bins were consumed. Base and dictionary identities are inherited producer provenance; no model/dictionary load or new forward was performed by this diagnostic.
